class.name: JRPGMapShapes
class.brief_description: The cells covered by the map drawing tools: lines, rectangles, ellipses and fills.
class.description: Static helpers for map drawing: the cells a pencil drags over, the filled rectangle or ellipse between two corners, and the area a fill covers. They work on cell coordinates only, so the editor's map canvas, its bridge tools and game code that draws on map data get the same cells. Results are in drawing order and hold each cell once; cells may lie outside the map, so clip them to the map's size before painting. A shape whose rectangle holds more than 1048576 cells is refused with an error.

method.name: get_ellipse
method.description: Returns the cells of the filled ellipse inscribed in the rectangle with corners [param from] and [param to]: those whose centers lie inside it, row by row.

method.name: get_flood_fill
method.description: Returns the cells connected to [param start] (up, down, left and right) that hold the same value as it in [param values], a grid of [param size] cells stored row by row, as [method JRPGMapData.get_layer] returns a layer. Returns an empty array when [param start] is outside the grid.

method.name: get_line
method.description: Returns every cell on the straight line from [param from] to [param to], both included, with no gaps between successive cells.

method.name: get_rectangle
method.description: Returns every cell of the rectangle with corners [param from] and [param to], both included, row by row.
